Date: 2022-08-30
REMARKS
Claims 9 and 16 are amended, claims 17-20 are newly added. Abstract is amended to be limited within 150 characters.
No new matter is added by this Preliminary Amendment.
CONCLUSION
In view of the above, the undersigned representative respectfully submits that the foregoing Response places this application in condition for allowance and a Notice to that effect is earnestly solicited. If the Examiner believes that there are any issues that can be resolved by a telephone conference, or that there are any informalities that can be corrected by an Examiner's amendment, please call the undersigned representative at the number given below.
The undersigned representative requests any extension of time that may be deemed necessary to further the prosecution of this application.
The undersigned representative authorizes the Commissioner to charge any additional fees under 37 C.F.R. 1.16 or 1.17 that may be required, or credit any overpayment, to Deposit Account No. 505142, referencing Attorney Docket No.: US87146.
Due to the Coronavirus (COVID-19) pandemic, if the undersigned representative cannot be reached by phone, Applicant respectfully requests the Examiner to email the undersigned representative using the email address provided below.
